fsid.description: The unique cluster identifier (UUID). Required for new deployments.

global_opts.description: Additional arbitrary key-value global options for ceph.conf (e.g., 'log_file = /var/log/ceph/$cluster-$name.log')

mgr_modules_enabled.description: List of ceph-mgr modules to enable. The 'cephadm' module must be enabled for orchestrator functionality.

mon_host.description: List of initial monitor hostnames/IPs (used during bootstrapping or fallback).

mon_initial_members.description: List of monitor names that are part of the initial quorum.

orchestrator_container_image_base.description: Base container image used by cephadm for deploying daemons.

orchestrator_enable_daemon_placement.description: When true, cephadm automatically places daemons (mon, mgr, osd, etc.) on hosts.

orchestrator_inventory_refresh_interval.description: Seconds between inventory scans of hosts (0 = disabled).

orchestrator_inventory_sources.description: List of custom inventory sources for cephadm. Each item defines a named source and its path.

name.description: Unique name for this inventory source (e.g., 'file', 'static', 'vmware').

path.description: Path to inventory file or source config (e.g., '/etc/ceph/inventory.yml').

orchestrator_secure_monitoring_stack.description: Enable secure TLS for the built-in monitoring stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager).

orchestrator_service_spec_refresh_interv.description: Seconds between refresh of scheduled service specs (0 = disabled).

osd_journal_size.description: Journal size in MB for non-db journaling (legacy filestore); ignored for bluestore.

osd_mkfs_options_xfs.description: Extra options for mkfs.xfs when creating OSDs.

osd_mount_options_xfs.description: Mount options for XFS filesystems used by OSDs.

prometheus_alertmanager_basic_password.description: Basic auth password for Alertmanager (if used).

prometheus_alertmanager_basic_user.description: Basic auth username for Alertmanager (if used).

prometheus_alertmanager_url.description: Optional external Alertmanager URL for alerting integration (e.g., 'https://alertmanager.example.com').

rbd_cache_writethrough_until_flush.description: If 'true', use writethrough mode until first flush (client-side).
